title: Big Dhamaka
desc: Two men look alike, with one of them being a successful businessman and the other trying to find work. Despite their differences, they end up falling for the same woman.

title: Businessman 2
desc: A money-minded tycoon gets into a beneficial relationship with a woman. Soon, he learns about the differences in his family and decides to end them.

title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

title: Khiladi
desc: Pooja, a criminologist, along with Arjun, a CBI official, tries to solve two interlinked cases of murder and money laundering. As they investigate the crimes, the conspiracy intensifies.

title: Ten Hours
desc: While searching for a missing girl, righteous police officer Castro stumbles upon a baffling homicide involving a passenger slain in total silence. He must rush to uncover the killer.
